deleted: Shown in an open issue that someone deleted meanwhile.
back: Button in the issue window when the issue couldn't be loaded or was deleted; it closes the window and returns to the board.
loading: Read by screen readers while an issue loads; {{key}} is its key (CB-12).
filed: Under an issue's title: who filed it and when. {{reporter}} is a person or a socio (AI agent), {{agent}} a connected agent's name, {{person}} the person a socio acted for, {{trigger}} how the socio's turn started (trigger.*), {{at}} the date and time. The forms add the agent, the socio's person, or both.
updated: Follows "filed" on the same line when the issue changed later; it starts with a space and a middle dot.
trigger.chat: Each trigger.* key: in parentheses after the person a socio filed for, how its turn started.
trigger.telegram: The socio's turn started from a message sent to it on Telegram.
trigger.scheduled: The socio's turn started from a scheduled task (a job set to run at set times).
trigger.goal: The socio was working on a goal the person set it.
section.description: Heading over the issue's description, in the issue window.
section.attachments: Heading over the files attached to the issue, in the issue window.
attach: Accessible name of the paperclip button that attaches files to the issue itself.
no-files: When an issue has no attachments; {{hint}} is a sentence listing the file types and size allowed.
tab.comments: Tab with the comments; the number is how many.
tab.history: Tab with the issue's history of changes; the number is how many.
fields: Accessible name of the side panel with the issue's fields.
title.label: Accessible name of the box where you edit the issue's title.
title.edit: Accessible name of the pencil button beside the issue's title that starts editing it.
body.label: Accessible name of the box where you edit the issue's description.
body.save: Button under the description box that saves the edited description.
body.empty: Shown in place of the description when the issue has none.
body.edit: Button that starts editing the issue's description.
save: Button that saves an edited title or comment.
cancel: Button that stops editing the title, description or a comment without saving.
keep: Button that cancels a delete (keeps the issue or comment).
field.status: Label of the issue's Status field in the issue window's side panel (also the field's name in the read-only list members see).
field.priority: Label of the issue's Priority field in the side panel.
field.kind: Label of the issue's Kind field in the side panel: what sort of issue it is (bug, feature...).
field.area: Label of the issue's Area field in the side panel: the part of the product it is about.
field.no-area: The Area field's value, and its menu choice, when the issue has no area.
field.labels: Label of the issue's Labels field in the side panel.
field.no-labels: The Labels field's value when the issue has no labels.
field.components: Name of the Components field (the plugins and apps the issue is about) in the read-only list of fields members see.
field.assignee: Label of the field with the person the issue is assigned to.
field.unassigned: The Assignee field's value, and its menu choice, when nobody is assigned.
field.deactivated: In the Assignee menu, a person whose account is deactivated.
field.resolution: Free text saying how an issue was resolved.
field.resolution-example: Placeholder of the Resolution field: an example. Keep the commit id (380fb4c) as is.
requesters.title: Heading of the list of socios (AI agents) that asked for this capability; the number is how many.
requesters.deleted-socio: In place of a socio's name once it was deleted.
requesters.for: After a socio's name: the person it asked for, and when.
requesters.none: Under requesters.title when no socio (AI agent) has asked for the capability yet.
delete.button: Button (admins only) at the bottom of the issue window's side panel; it asks to confirm before deleting.
delete.group: Accessible name of the delete confirmation; {{key}} is the issue's key.
delete.warning: Confirmation text before an admin deletes an issue; {{key}} is the issue's key (CB-12).
delete.confirm: Button that confirms deleting the issue; {{key}} is its key.
delete.done: Toast after an issue was deleted; {{key}} is its key.
comments.for: A comment's author: {{name}} is a socio or a connected agent, {{person}} the person it acted for.
comments.empty: In the Comments tab of an issue when nobody has commented.
comments.add: Accessible name of the box where you write a new comment on the issue.
comments.attach: Accessible name of the paperclip button under the comment box.
comments.posting: Text of the post button while the comment is being sent.
comments.edited: After a comment's time, when it was edited.
comments.edit: Button on your own comment that starts editing it.
comments.edit-label: Accessible name of the box where you edit a comment.
comments.delete: Button on a comment that deletes it, after you confirm.
comments.delete-confirm: Button that confirms deleting the comment.
history.for: A history row's author: {{name}} is a socio or a connected agent, {{person}} the person it acted for.
history.none: A field's value when it had none, inside the history.* rows.
history.a-file: Stands for a file whose name the history didn't keep.
history.empty: Each history.* key: what the author did, after their name ("Ada changed status from Open to Done"). Lowercase start, like the rest of a sentence. {{from}} and {{to}} are field values, {{key}} an issue's key, {{person}} a person's name.
history.created: History row: the author filed (created) the issue.
history.imported: History row: the author brought the issue in from another tracker, keeping its number, instead of filing it here.
history.title: History row: {{title}} is the issue's new title.
history.assigned: History row on an issue's History tab: the author made {{person}} (a person's name) the issue's assignee.
history.unassigned: History row on an issue's History tab: the author removed the issue's assignee, so nobody is assigned.
history.body: History row on an issue's History tab: the author changed the issue's description.
history.comment_added: History row: the author added a comment.
history.comment_edited: History row on an issue's History tab: the author changed one of the issue's comments.
history.comment_deleted: History row on an issue's History tab: the author removed one of the issue's comments.
history.attachment_added: History row: {{name}} is the attached file's name.
history.attachment_deleted: History row: {{name}} is the removed file's name.
history.deleted: History row: the author deleted the issue.
history.labels: History row: {{from}} and {{to}} are the issue's labels before and after, as a list.
history.status: History row: the author moved the issue between statuses (board columns); {{from}} and {{to}} are the old and new status, already translated.
history.priority: History row: {{from}} and {{to}} are the issue's old and new priority, already translated.
history.kind: History row: {{from}} and {{to}} are the issue's old and new kind (such as Bug or Feature), already translated.
history.area: History row: {{from}} and {{to}} are the issue's old and new product area, already translated.
history.blocked_by-lifted: The issue no longer waits for {{key}}.
history.blocks-lifted: {{key}} no longer waits for this issue.
history.changed: A change to another field; {{field}} is the field's name as stored, in English.
history.resolution: History row: {{resolution}} is the resolution text the author wrote (how the issue was resolved).
history.resolution-cleared: History row: the author removed the issue's resolution (the note on how it was resolved or why it won't be fixed).
history.related: History row: {{key}} is the key (CB-12) of the issue linked as related.
history.related-lifted: History row: the author removed the link between this issue and another one; {{key}} is the other issue's key, such as CB-12.
history.triage-proposed: History row: the author (usually a socio, an AI agent) suggested a triage, values for the issue's fields that an admin can accept.
history.triage-applied: History row on an issue's History tab: the author accepted the triage proposal (suggested values for the issue's fields), so those values were set.
history.triage-ignored: History row on an issue's History tab: the author dismissed the triage proposal without using it.
history.components-added: {{names}} are plugins' or apps' names, an issue's components.
history.components-removed: History row: {{names}} are the names of the plugins or apps removed from the issue's components.
history.components-both: Both changes in one row: {{added}} is history.components-added, {{removed}} history.components-removed.
history.components: History row when the components changed but the names are not known.
triage.title: Triage: sorting a new issue (kind, priority, area). A model proposes; an admin applies or ignores the proposal.
triage.applied: Toast after an admin applied the triage proposal (the suggested kind, priority and area).
triage.ignored: Toast after an admin ignored the triage proposal.
triage.decided: Who applied the proposal, and when.
triage.kind: Tooltip of the tag in the triage proposal that shows the suggested kind.
triage.area: Tooltip of the tag in the triage proposal that shows the suggested area.
triage.priority: Tooltip of the suggested priority in the triage proposal; {{priority}} is a priority's name.
triage.label: Tooltip of a tag in the triage proposal that shows a suggested label.
triage.component: Tooltip of a suggested component in the triage proposal; {{name}} is the plugin's or app's name.
triage.apply: Button (admins only) that applies the triage proposal to the issue.
triage.ignore: Button (admins only) that dismisses the triage proposal without changing the issue.
triage.waiting: Shown to people who aren't admins.
links.relation.related: Each links.relation.* key: in a menu, how this issue relates to another.
links.relation.blocks: Menu choice: this issue must be done before the other one.
links.relation.blocked_by: Menu choice: this issue waits for the other one.
links.group.blocked_by: Each links.group.* key: a heading over the linked issues of that relation.
links.group.blocks: Heading over the issues that wait for this one.
links.group.related: Heading over the issues linked as related.
links.enter-key: Error when the box doesn't hold an issue number; {{example}} is one (CB-12).
links.type-of: Accessible name of the menu that changes a link's type; {{key}} is the other issue's key.
links.remove: Accessible name of the × button that removes a link; {{key}} is the other issue's key.
links.title: Heading of the issue window's section with links to other issues.
links.empty: In the links section when the issue has no links.
links.type: Accessible name of the menu that chooses the kind of link (blocks, blocked by, related) before adding it.
links.issue: Accessible name of the box where you type the issue to link.
links.add: Button that adds the link to the issue typed in the box.
links.hint: "Done" and "Won't fix" are statuses (issues.terms status.done and status.wont_fix): use the same words.
